operations.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec rer install
operations.verify: pnpm check:deployment-spec && pnpm exec rer check --profile first-party && pnpm run verify
operations.recovery: Follow OPERATIONS.md and docs/backup-and-restore.md. Export the private native archive before changes. Restore only into an empty Linen installation, configure the original owner and keep the Adoption hold until every unknown external effect is reconciled.
